title: Stratum sync response v2
description: Body of GET /api/internal/sync on the control plane, and format of the gateway's standalone config file (STRATUM_CONFIG_FILE). Compatibility rule: the control plane at version N must serve gateways at N-1, and the gateway at N must understand control planes at N-1. Adding optional fields is compatible; removing or retyping a field is not.

current_version.description: Highest version in the control plane. The gateway sends it back as since_version on the next delta.

next_sync_in_seconds.description: Suggested wait before the next sync. Gateways clamp it to [5, 300].

models.description: The models the organization can use: catalog models it has not turned off, and models a provider listed for it, of providers it configured. Not versioned: sent with every sync, full or delta; a response that carries it replaces the list. Gateways answer GET /v1/models with the ones the caller's policy allows. Control planes before 0.4 do not send it.

people.description: The people directory: who a key with delegates = true may act for (X-Stratum-User), and under which team. Ids only. A full sync sends every person of the organization; a delta, the ones that changed. Control planes before 0.4 do not send it, and then no person can be acted for.

integer.description: Integer. Numeric strings are accepted for compatibility with control planes that serialise PostgreSQL BIGINT as text; new producers must emit numbers.

policy.description: A team's policy. One entry per team; a policy shared by several teams appears once per team. version is the newer of the policy's version and the team's assignment, so moving a team to another policy always replaces the previous entry. A team without a policy, or deleted, is sent with revoked = true and an empty id: the team is disabled.

denied_models.description: Models the organization turned off, with every ID and alias, bare and as provider/ID. Refused even when allow_all_models is true. Gateways older than 0.2 ignore it.

monthly_budget_usd.description: The team's own monthly budget when it has one, the policy's otherwise. Gateways from 0.3 refuse the team's requests (budget_exceeded) once month_usage reports that much spend.

max_tokens_per_request.description: Most output tokens a request may ask for; null or absent: no limit. Gateways from 0.3 lower requests that ask for more, and set it on requests that ask for nothing.

apiKey.description: A developer key. Only the SHA-256 hex digest is ever transmitted. A key that stops working (revoked, removed, its user deactivated or left without a team, or deleted) is sent with revoked = true, never just left out. When the control plane no longer has the hash (a removed or deleted key), key_hash is empty.

id.description: Opaque to gateways. A user key carries the user id; an agent key carries "agent:" and the agent id.

key_hash.description: Empty only when revoked is true.

default_provider.description: Agent keys only, optional. With default_model: every request of this key goes to this provider.

default_model.description: Agent keys only, optional. Every request of this key goes to this model, whatever model it asks for. Gateways that predate this field ignore it.

delegates.description: Optional, false when absent. The key may send X-Stratum-User with the id of a person in the people directory: the request then follows that person's team policy and its usage is reported as theirs. Gateways before 0.4 ignore it and refuse nothing, since they do not read the header.

id.description: The model's ID at the provider, as a request names it.

name.description: Display name, when the catalog has one.

person.description: A person a key that delegates may act for. revoked = true (deactivated, without a team, without access to applications, or deleted) makes the gateway refuse requests on their behalf; a deleted person arrives with an empty team_id.

providerConfig.description: The customer's credentials for an upstream provider. api_key is plaintext on the wire (TLS + sync token) and must be encrypted at rest by the gateway. In a standalone config file it may be written as "env:VAR_NAME". A deleted config is sent with revoked = true and enabled = false.

monthUsage.description: Each team's usage in the current UTC month, as the control plane counted it from every gateway's usage reports, with the cost it computed at the organization's prices. Not versioned: sent with every sync, full or delta. Gateways use the tokens as a floor for monthly_token_quota (their own count may have been reset or cover only one replica) and the cost for monthly_budget_usd. Teams without usage are left out. Control planes before 0.3 do not send it.
